description: Return a VaneUI component's boolean props, one line per category, default marked `*`. By default (`compact`) it lists the component's own props and names the shared layout categories it takes; slug `common` lists those once. detail `full` adds descriptions and every shared prop. Value props such as `label` or `title` are in `vaneui://docs/<slug>`. The slug is the resource basename: `button`, `card`, `icon-button`, etc.

slug.description: Component slug, or `common` for the shared layout props.

name: get_component_props
